items.q: Do UTM tags change how my page looks?
items.a: No. They only add tracking tags to the link, and visitors see the same page.
Yes. 'Facebook' and 'facebook' appear as separate sources in Google Analytics, so keep them lowercase. The tool can clean them for you.

items.q: Is the UTM link builder free?
items.a: Yes. The UTM link builder is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
Your five most recent links are kept in your own browser so you can reuse them. They are not sent to us.

items.q: Can you set up tracking for my ads?
items.a: Yes. Tracking and UTMs are set up before launch by our performance marketing team.
